inv.desc_es:
TRASPASO DE BAR DE DESAYUNOS EN LA PAZ – TOTALMENTE EQUIPADO

Se traspasa acogedor bar de desayunos en la zona de La Paz, Málaga, en una ubicación muy bien comunicada y próxima a la playa.

El local cuenta con 35 m2 construidos y se encuentra completamente equipado, listo para continuar la actividad y empezar a trabajar. Su ambiente acogedor lo convierte en un espacio ideal para ofrecer desayunos, cafés y pequeños aperitivos.

Ubicación privilegiada:

- A solo 8 minutos andando de la playa.
- A 2 minutos andando de la estación de metro de La Paz.
- Situado en una zona con buenas comunicaciones y servicios cercanos.

Una excelente oportunidad para emprendedores o profesionales de la hostelería que busquen un negocio en funcionamiento o un espacio preparado para desarrollar su propio concepto.

Local acogedor, totalmente equipado y con una ubicación excelente.

Para más información sobre las condiciones del traspaso, no dudes en contactar.

No pierdas esta oportunidad de vivir en una de las mejores zonas de Málaga. ¡Contáctanos para concertar una visita! No dude en llamarnos y visite la vivienda con Inmobiliarias BLANHOGAR, una de las Agencias Malagueñas con una trayectoria excelente desde el año 2.000, un trato familiar y con todos los servicios que usted necesita para acceder a la compra de su hogar. Nos encontramos en Avenida Velázquez, 60 (junto a la Volkswagen) en horario de mañana y tarde (de 9:30h a 14h y de 17h a 20:30h). Además los sábados previa cita, nuestros Agentes les atenderán en horario de mañanas.

We specialize in selling apartments, studios, and residential properties in the beautiful city of Málaga, Spain. Whether you are looking for a holiday home, an investment opportunity, or a permanent residence, we are here to help. Our experienced team provides personalized assistance to international buyers, making the entire purchasing process simple, secure, and stress-free. Discover your ideal property in Málaga with us.

Transparencia y normativa vigente:

Este anuncio cumple con la Ley 10/2025, de servicios de atención a la clientela, garantizando información clara, veraz y accesible sobre el inmueble y sus condiciones.

Asimismo, en cumplimiento del Decreto 218/2005 de la Junta de Andalucía, informamos de que los gastos notariales, registrales, ITP, gastos financieros y demás costes inherentes a la compraventa no están incluidos en el precio. Honorarios de la intermediación no incluidos (5.000 € mas IVA).
inv.desc_en:
BREAKFAST BAR FOR TRANSFER IN LA PAZ – FULLY EQUIPPED

Cozy breakfast bar for transfer in the La Paz area, Málaga, in a very well-connected location close to the beach.

The premises have 35 m2 of built area and are fully equipped, ready to continue operations and start working. Its cozy atmosphere makes it an ideal space for offering breakfasts, coffees, and small snacks.

Privileged location:

- Just an 8-minute walk from the beach.
- A 2-minute walk from the La Paz metro station.
- Located in an area with good transport links and nearby services.

An excellent opportunity for entrepreneurs or hospitality professionals looking for an operating business or a space prepared to develop their own concept.

Cozy premises, fully equipped, and with an excellent location.

For more information on the transfer conditions, do not hesitate to contact us.

Do not miss this opportunity to be in one of the best areas of Málaga. Contact us to arrange a visit! Do not hesitate to call us and visit the property with Inmobiliarias BLANHOGAR, one of the Málaga agencies with an excellent track record since the year 2000, offering a familiar approach and all the services you need to access the purchase of your home. We are located at Avenida Velázquez, 60 (next to Volkswagen) with morning and afternoon hours (from 9:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 5:00 PM to 8:30 PM). Additionally, on Saturdays by appointment, our agents will assist you in the morning.

We specialize in selling apartments, studios, and residential properties in the beautiful city of Málaga, Spain. Whether you are looking for a holiday home, an investment opportunity, or a permanent residence, we are here to help. Our experienced team provides personalized assistance to international buyers, making the entire purchasing process simple, secure, and stress-free. Discover your ideal property in Málaga with us.

Transparency and current regulations:

This advertisement complies with Law 10/2025 on customer service, guaranteeing clear, truthful, and accessible information about the property and its conditions.

Likewise, in compliance with Decree 218/2005 of the Regional Government of Andalusia, we inform you that notary fees, registration fees, ITP (Property Transfer Tax), financial expenses, and other costs inherent to the sale are not included in the price. Intermediation fees are not included (€5,000 plus VAT).
